text:
maria: seeing a weird spike where a bunch of premium traffic is getting routed to our EU-aux region even though EU capacity looks fine :thinking_face:
aj: I can confirm — console shows premium->eu-primary healthy, but routing decisions show eu-aux churn at 10:12 UTC
olive: telemetry shows a sudden bump in route_failures + fallback_reroutes at 10:11:33, correlated with quota_gate decisions
dennis: any recent changes to tier routing rules? I pushed a small change to the routing policy last night but it was scoped to standard tier only
maria: deploy-bot shows a canary for routing.service rolled at 02:04 today, but rollout flag was off for premium. still, worth verifying: @deploy-bot logs?
deploy-bot: canary rollout finished successfully, no premium flag flips detected :white_check_mark:
aj: dumping current policy snippet from configstore:
```
priority: ["region", "tier"]
fallback_order: ["variant_v1", "variant_q8"]
quota_gate: {
  enabled: true,
  threshold_pct: 90
}
```
kevin: aha — note priority: region first. that means if eu-primary reports any throttling, we may pick eu-aux even for premium if quota_gate trips.
maria: but eu-primary reported no throttling. why did quota_gate trip?
olive: look at the percent calc: quota_gate uses 1m rolling tokens / provisioned_tokens. we had a short KV-cache miss storm increasing per-request token counts for a subset of customers, that inflated the numerator for minutes
dennis: so quota_gate believed capacity was lower than it actually was, triggered fallback to aux, causing cross-region routing spike
aj: and aux can't serve some premium variant encodings, so fallback to variant_q8 is invoked — variant bounce occurs and triggers more quota gating because latency jumps -> tokens consumed increases -> more falls back
maria: cascade confirmed. this is a variant-bounce amplification loop. :boom:
kevin: mitigation options: 1) temp disable quota_gate for premium, 2) change priority to ["tier","region"] so we prefer keeping premium in-region, 3) increase debounce window on quota_gate so short spikes don't flip it
olive: telemetry team recommends option 3 as short-term, plus a hotfix to correct per-request token accounting for KV-cache misses (root cause)
dennis: I'll prepare a PR to add a 30s hysteresis to quota_gate and a quick guard to ignore spikes when cache_miss_rate > X
maria: can someone flip premium quota_gate to off for 15m so we stop the churn now? ops? @kevin
kevin: flipping now. I'll add a config annotation and notify SRE. :hammer_and_wrench:
kevin: flipped premium.quota_gate.enabled = false (reason: emergency mitigation). watching metrics
sre-bot: alert mute applied for routing-fallback-alerts for 15m by kevin
aj: after the mute, fallback_reroutes dropped to baseline in ~40s. latency for premium decreased too
maria: follow-ups: 1) roll the hotfix accounting change 2) add hysteresis + percent decay to quota_gate 3) add dashboard tile for variant-bounce chains 4) run a replay test to ensure policy priority change doesn't regress other tiers
olive: I'll file the telemetry tickets and attach the graphs. dennis, can you include the cache_miss trace in the PR?
dennis: yep. PR in progress, will tag @maria and @olive for review
maria: thanks all. good catch. let's avoid auto-fallback loops in the future. :pray:
